policy: Seven usable geometric plans pass structural/shallow/full plan-lint but NONE passes full source-feature parity. The eighth, 025q03, has a validated diagnostic geometry yet is explicitly status:UNSUPPORTED so official lint skips it and render-plan refuses production because the source is mathematically inconsistent. Never treat plan-lint PASS/UNSUPPORTED as mathematical or rendered acceptance. Only the official SVG engine may add visual features; do not publish 025q03 until source, choices and solution are corrected.
